label: Quest
description: Simple Rune is an introductory task given to novice dwarven warriors in Coldridge Valley. Passed along by Sten Stoutarm on behalf of the warrior trainer…
intro: Simple Rune is an introductory task given to novice dwarven warriors in Coldridge Valley. Passed along by Sten Stoutarm on behalf of the warrior trainer Thran Khorman, it directs fresh recruits inside Anvilmar to begin their martial training.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the warrior trainer Thran. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Blast it's cold today, ain't it? It's like the snow never goes away, friend.

You've probably noticed already, but there are gnomes now living in our city. That's because they went and got themselves blown out of their own home. Don't go spreadin' this 'round, but I can hardly blame them—I think I woulda resorted to explosives too if Ironforge were infested with Dark Irons or the like.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Other things you'll probably see too, just so yer in the know: dwarves usin' magic in a fight 'stead of a rifle. Some of us takin' to worshippin' the Holy Light like some of the humans, and, last but not least, troggs. You'll learn more 'bout them later, but What you need to know now is that I'm here to help ya.
I be here to teach ya how to be a real adventurer. Anytime ya think ya need more trainin', come back to me and I'll see what I can do.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
